card.fact_statement: The Arrest of Awami League leaders took place as several figures associated with the administration attempted to flee Bangladesh.
card.source_span: === Arrest of Awami League leaders === In addition to Sheikh Hasina, several figures associated with her administration and the Awami League fled or attempted to flee Bangladesh.

target_qa_variants.question: ¿Qué evento durante el movimiento de no cooperación de 2024 ocurrió mientras varias figuras asociadas con la administración intentaban huir de Bangladesh?
target_qa_variants.expected_answer: Arresto de líderes de la Liga Awami
target_qa_variants.source_span: === Arrest of Awami League leaders === In addition to Sheikh Hasina, several figures associated with her administration and the Awami League fled or attempted to flee Bangladesh.
